reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a musical eighth note inside a counterclockwise circular arrow, signifying replaying/looping audio, listening history, or restoring music files. While originated as a media player control, it fits specific tasks around audio loops, music backups, listening history, and rehearsal playback, though general music tasks are better served by a plain note or instrument icon.
